what: Author, a software developer, describes creating images using AI tools, turning mental prompts into visuals, then making a Gumroad page to share and sell them.
verbatim_snippet: "I'm not a professional artist. I didn't study art. I don't even think of myself as 'creative' in the traditional sense. But I feel things. And sometimes, those feelings come out in colors, textures, light, and shadow — through images I create using AI tools. I started generating images simply because it made me happy. I'd see a prompt in my head and try to turn it into something visual. Some of them are weird. Some are moody. Some even surprised me. And one day, I thought: why not put them somewhere? So I made a Gumroad page."
